source.amplitude: block wander results/noise_v3/wander/michaels.json: sigma2 = (sigma_v ln10/20)^2 capped at v4_priors.amp_cap, gamma = 1/(2 pi tau_v), per order group
source.phase: prior medians: sigma2 = exp(PHASE_SIGMA2_LN[0]); W = c_W x 0.6745

array_response.rule: per-channel transfer: each mic's deviation from the array mean on the 24 third-octave bands 34-6842 Hz, mean over the rig's 11 real windows (rigs.<rig>.levels_db.full), interpolated in log f and held flat beyond the outer bands, re-centred on the channels used; each channel's periodogram is divided by 10^(g/10)

mic_response.geometry_rule: Delta G_rm = G_rm - mean_r G_rm, G = -20 log10 d_rm (data_processing.sources.michaels.get_geometry)

optimiser.restart_pass_iters: half the pass it restarts (fresh L-BFGS memory)
optimiser.evidence_freeze: not run: the flight fit holds the phase pedestal at its prior medians (spec § Procedure B), so there is nothing to freeze

convergence.test: the all-frames polish's fresh-memory restart pass

priors.floor_z: N(0, I), control values mu + sigma_B (L z)
priors.floor_push: +kappa sum_j cbar_j on the log prior (dB)

measured.floor_rule: per frame and mic the minimum in each run of bins between neighbouring lines of all rotors (+-1 bin excluded) x run length, over the unit floor x (sum_r g_rm sbar^b_init + s_init); mean per bin, median per spline cell; mu = mean, sigma_B = rms about it
measured.init_rule: spec § Initialisation steps 1-5 (no earlier fit read)

channel_gains.rule: per-channel transfer: each mic's deviation from the array mean on the 24 third-octave bands 34-6842 Hz, mean over the rig's 11 real windows (rigs.<rig>.levels_db.full), interpolated in log f and held flat beyond the outer bands, re-centred on the channels used; each channel's periodogram is divided by 10^(g/10)
